title: The Qinling Bronze Occult Chronicles
description: An AI-generated, live-action-style Chinese mystery microdrama (秦岭青铜诡事录) in which a mysterious bronze tomb tied to a 1971 mining disaster reawakens deep in the Qinling Mountains.
descriptionMore: Former reconnaissance soldier Qin Yue leads an expedition into the reopened tomb, where ancient rituals and supernatural forces conceal the truth behind a blood sacrifice spanning two generations. Produced by Yaoke Media with Studio 42, the series reportedly drew 13.76 million cumulative views on Tencent Video within its first 12 hours of release.
